audit_metadata.auditor: Independent Software Auditor & Scientific Quality Evaluator

findings.title: Routing Gating Defect: Single-cell analysis is structurally skipped if no primary target gene is in the query
reproduction_steps: Upload or reference an AnnData single-cell file: 'Analyze this uploaded test_atlas.h5ad dataset.'
Do not include any target gene symbol (e.g. KRAS, EGFR) in the query.
Observe orchestrator execution path in backend logs and result payload.
findings.evidence: In line 388, Stage 2 computational execution is gated strictly under 'if is_simulation_intent or primary_target:'. Because no primary target is present and no simulation keywords exist, Stage 2 is skipped entirely. In CASE-20 of the evaluation suite, Lumicell did not run and selected_agents only included ['Lithoscribe'].
findings.acceptance_criteria: Single-cell dataset analysis must be gated on dataset reference detection (e.g., presence of .h5ad / .zarr or single-cell transcriptomic intent), completely independent of whether a target gene symbol is present.

findings.title: Routing Defect: Literature-only requests trigger COPASI ODE simulations when a target gene is named
reproduction_steps: Send query: 'Find KRAS papers only.' or 'Review recent Phase 2 clinical trials for HER2 antibody-drug conjugates in breast cancer without running simulations.'
Observe backend execution logs and selected_agents in response payload.
findings.evidence: In line 388, Vivarix simulation is dispatched if 'is_simulation_intent or primary_target'. When a target is extracted ('KRAS' or 'HER2'), Vivarix automatically queries BioModels and runs COPASI ODE simulation. In CASE-11 and CASE-12, Vivarix was invoked despite explicit user directives 'papers only' and 'without running simulations'.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Simulation dispatch must require simulation intent (explicit model accession or kinetic/ODE keywords) and must respect negative constraints ('papers only', 'without simulation').

findings.title: Argument Contract Mismatch: KEGG pathway retrieval tool fails input validation on 100% of orchestrator calls
reproduction_steps: Execute any inquiry with a primary target (e.g. 'Analyze KRAS G12D signaling').
Inspect tool_results['synapta'].data['pathways'].
findings.evidence: In registry.py line 250, SynaptaKeggInput requires 'target_symbol: str'. In authoritative_orchestrator.py line 296, the call is 'await registry.execute("synapta_kegg_pathways", query=f"pathway/{target_symbol}")'. The registry input validation catches a missing target_symbol and returns a VALIDATION_ERROR. In all executions, pathways defaults to empty list [].
findings.acceptance_criteria: Align caller argument to 'target_symbol=target_symbol' in authoritative_orchestrator.py, or update SynaptaKeggInput to accept 'query: str'.

findings.title: Discovery Scorer: Hardcoded Constant Discovery Components (0.75)
reproduction_steps: Run two materially different COPASI simulations (e.g. one with high flux change and one with near-zero drift).
Inspect composite_priority_score and components in DiscoveryHypothesisReport.
findings.evidence: Line 142 sets 'sim_flux_change = 0.75' whenever final_concentrations exist, regardless of actual concentration deltas. Line 175 sets 'single_cell_marker_evidence = 0.75 if sc_executed else None'. Both modalities yield an invariant 0.75 constant component.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Compute dynamic kinetic flux variation: calculate actual normalized relative concentration delta across species; compute single-cell score from actual log fold-change and FDR p-values.

findings.title: Scientific Quality Defect: Final time-course values labeled as steady states in UI and agent thoughts
reproduction_steps: Run inquiry: 'Simulate MAPK activation in BIOMD0000000010 over 60 seconds.'
Observe the table title and column header in the rendered Vivarix artifact card.
findings.evidence: The React UI header reads 'STEADY-STATE CONCENTRATION READOUTS' and the column reads 'Steady/Final Conc', and the orchestrator thought emits 'Computed dynamic trajectory and final steady-state concentrations'. However, the simulation is a 60-second time course (LSODA ODE) where convergence_status is transient dynamics, and compute_steady_state (Newton-Raphson Jacobian root-finding) was never executed.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Distinguish between transient time-course endpoints ('Final Time-Course Concentrations (at t=60s)') and validated steady states computed via basico.run_steadystate().

findings.title: Verifier Defect: Clinical trial assertions permitted without semantic entailment checking
reproduction_steps: Generate a response asserting 'Phase 3 trial readouts confirmed 85% objective response rate and curative efficacy' for a target.
Provide 2 literature passages on completely unrelated general biochemistry.
Observe verification report.
findings.evidence: In verifier.py line 204, 'has_substantive_lit = len(observed_passages) >= 2'. If 2 passages exist, the verifier does not flag CLINICAL_CLAIM defects, regardless of whether the passages actually support the specific clinical claim.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Implement semantic passage grounding or strict regex entity-metric cross-validation to ensure cited trials and percentages exist within the retrieved passage texts.

findings.title: Verifier Defect: Ensembl and UniProt identifiers extracted but never audited
reproduction_steps: Include a fictitious Ensembl ID ('ENSG99999999999') or UniProt ID ('P99999') in the response text.
Run verifier.verify_response.
Check defects list.
findings.evidence: While _extract_identifiers extracts Ensembl and UniProt and collects observed sets, there are only validation loops for biomodels (lines 148-159), dois (lines 162-173), and pmids (lines 176-187). Ensembl and UniProt have no check loop, allowing unobserved or fabricated accessions to pass without defect flags.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add audit loops for extracted_ids['ensembl'] and extracted_ids['uniprot'] enforcing that every cited identifier must exist in observed_ensembl or observed_uniprot.

findings.title: Verifier False Positives: Flawed numerical regex triggers false mismatch defects on phosphorylated species prefixes
reproduction_steps: Generate a response stating: 'Mos-P reached 65.87 nM while Mos was 34.13 nM'.
Execute verifier on simulation outputs containing both species.
findings.evidence: In line 239, pattern is rf"{re.escape(sp_name)}[^\d\n\r]{{1,40}}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)". Because it lacks word boundaries (\b), auditing 'Mos' matches 'Mos-P reached 65.87' and flags a 93% relative error against actual Mos (34.13). In the audit evaluation suite, this defect generated 396 false NUMERICAL defects across 14 cases. Furthermore, it ignores negative numbers (\d+ only) and ignores concentration units.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Use strict word boundary matching (\b{sp_name}\b), parse concentration units (nM, uM, mM), and capture signed floats.

findings.title: Authentication & Tenant Isolation Missing: All API endpoints operate unauthenticated with 'default_user'
reproduction_steps: Call GET /api/memory/thread/{thread_id} or DELETE /api/memory/clear from any unauthenticated HTTP client.
Observe that all endpoints succeed without credentials.
findings.evidence: ChatRequest schema lacks user_id; all turns are recorded under user_id='default_user'. There is no auth middleware or token validation on memory search, session reset, or deletion endpoints.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Implement API key or JWT bearer authentication on all FastAPI routes, scope memory nodes by authenticated user_id, and prevent cross-user memory leakage.

findings.title: Cosmetic UI Controls: Orchestration framework selector has no backend functionality
reproduction_steps: Select 'Hierarchical Supervisor' vs 'Multi-Agent Swarm' vs 'Decentralized Peer-to-Peer' in the UI dropdown.
Inspect backend execution path and returned framework_used.
findings.evidence: In app/backend/main.py, orch.execute_inquiry does not accept a framework parameter. The backend always executes AuthoritativeOrchestrator, and result.framework_used is hardcoded to 'authoritative-react-compiler'.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Either implement framework-specific orchestration branches (e.g. Swarm vs Supervisor) or remove cosmetic options from the UI to reflect the actual architecture.

findings.title: CI & Test Suite Defect: Lithoscribe test suite crashes during collection due to unchecked top-level OpenAI client instantiation
reproduction_steps: Run 'uv run pytest phronesis/lithoscribe/tests/' without OPENAI_API_KEY exported in the environment.
findings.evidence: Pytest aborts during collection with: 'openai.OpenAIError: The api_key client option must be set'. 363 tests cannot be collected or executed.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Wrap LLM instantiation inside fixtures or test functions with monkeypatch/mock, or guard with pytest.mark.skipif.

findings.title: Research Claims vs Implementation: Benchmark claims (BFCL, STaRK, BixBench) in test docstrings are local smoke tests
reproduction_steps: Inspect test_bfcl_tool_registry_validation_and_rejection and test_stark_target_disease_association_retrieval.
findings.evidence: Tests define local mock Pydantic models or execute single OpenTargets queries. The official Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard dataset, STaRK benchmark questions, and BixBench benchmark datasets were never downloaded or evaluated.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Accurately document test suites as integration and regression suites inspired by benchmark principles, rather than claiming official benchmark scores.

findings.title: Dynamic BioModels Search & SBML Stream Loading Working
reproduction_steps: Query: 'Simulate KRAS using BIOMD0000000048 for 100 seconds.'
Observe live query to https://www.biomodels.org/search and stream download of BIOMD0000000048_url.xml.
findings.evidence: FastAPI log shows HTTP 200 from https://www.biomodels.org/search and https://www.biomodels.org/model/download/BIOMD0000000048. Real COPASI ODE integration ran for 100s, returning dynamic trajectory and species readouts.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Preserve live BioModels search and streaming SBML loading.

findings.title: Single-Cell Synthetic Data Removed on Product Path
reproduction_steps: Query: 'Perform single-cell transcriptomic clustering and cell type annotation for KRAS tumor microenvironment.'
Observe returned error state.
findings.evidence: Tool returned success=False with ErrorType.DATASET_REQUIRED: 'Single-cell transcriptomics analysis requires a real dataset or uploaded AnnData file (.h5ad / .zarr) with provenance. No dataset was provided.' No synthetic cells or clusters were fabricated.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Maintain strict real-dataset provenance requirements for single-cell analytics.

findings.title: Persistent Memory BM25 Probabilistic Ranking and Contradiction Tracking Working
reproduction_steps: Run test_mem0_thread_isolation_and_bm25_retrieval and test_mem0_contradiction_detection in test_scientific_validation.py.
findings.evidence: All thread isolation, BM25 term weighting (k1=1.5, b=0.75), and contradiction status updates passed with 100% assertions in test_scientific_validation.py.
